1: // Canvas Dodge game with enhanced graphics
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   // Set canvas size to its displayed size
7:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
8:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
9: 
10:   // Audio setup
11:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
12:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
13:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
14:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
15:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
16:     osc.type = 'sine';
17:     gain.gain.value = 0.1;
18:     osc.connect(gain);
19:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
20:     osc.start();
21:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
22:   }

24:   // Initialize background stars
25:   const starCount = 80;
26:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
27:     stars.push({
28:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
29:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
30:       r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
31:       phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
32:     });
33:   }
34: 
35:   const player = {
36:     w: 30,
37:     h: 30,
38:     x: canvas.width / 2 - 15,
39:     y: canvas.height - 40,
40:     speed: 5,
41:     color: '#0af',
42:     move(dx) {
43:       this.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - this.w, this.x + dx));
44:     }
45:   };
46: 
47:   const circles = [];
48:   const stars = [];
49:   let lastSpawn = 0;
50:   const spawnInterval = 1000; // ms
51:   let gameOver = false;
52:   let score = 0;
53: 
54:   function spawnCircle() {
55:     const radius = 15 + Math.random() * 10;
56:     circles.push({
57:       x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - 2 * radius) + radius,
58:       y: -radius,
59:       r: radius,
60:       speed: 2 + Math.random() * 2,
61:     });
62:   }
63: 
64:   function update(dt) {
65:     // animate stars twinkling
66:     for (const s of stars) {
67:       s.phase += 0.02;
68:       s.r = 1 + Math.sin(s.phase) * 0.5;
69:     }
70:     if (gameOver) return;
71:     // spawn
72:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
73:       spawnCircle();
74:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
75:     }
76:     // move circles
77:     for (let i = circles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
78:       const c = circles[i];
79:       c.y += c.speed;
80:       if (c.y - c.r > canvas.height) {
81:         circles.splice(i, 1);
82:         score++;
83:         playTone(400, 0.08); // point sound
84:       } else if (rectCircleCollide(player, c)) {
85:         gameOver = true;
86:         playTone(100, 0.5); // collision/game over sound
87:       }
88:     }
89:   }
90: 
91:   function draw() {
92:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
93:     // Draw background gradient
94:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
95:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
96:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#004');
97:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
98:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
99:     // draw stars (background)
100:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
101:     for (const s of stars) {
102:       ctx.beginPath();
103:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
104:       ctx.fill();
105:     }
106:     // player
107:     // draw player with rounded gradient
108:     const playerGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, player.y, 0, player.y + player.h);
109:     playerGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0af');
110:     playerGrad.addColorStop(1, '#005');
111:     ctx.fillStyle = playerGrad;
112:     const radius = 6;
113:     ctx.beginPath();
114:     ctx.moveTo(player.x + radius, player.y);
115:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w - radius, player.y);
116:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x + player.w, player.y, player.x + player.w, player.y + radius);
117:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h - radius);
118:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h, player.x + player.w - radius, player.y + player.h);
119:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + radius, player.y + player.h);

137:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';

142:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';

151:     loop.last = timestamp;

153:     draw();
154:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);

159:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
160:       player.move(-player.speed);

162:     } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
163:       player.move(player.speed);
164:       playTone(200, 0.05);

166:   });
167:   canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
168:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
169:     const mx = e.clientX - rect.left;
170:     player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - player.w, mx - player.w / 2));
171:   });
172: 
173:   function rectCircleCollide(rect, circle) {
174:     const distX = Math.abs(circle.x - (rect.x + rect.w / 2));
175:     const distY = Math.abs(circle.y - (rect.y + rect.h / 2));
176:     if (distX > rect.w / 2 + circle.r) return false;
177:     if (distY > rect.h / 2 + circle.r) return false;
178:     if (distX <= rect.w / 2) return true;
179:     if (distY <= rect.h / 2) return true;
180:     const dx = distX - rect.w / 2;
181:     const dy = distY - rect.h / 2;
182:     return dx * dx + dy * dy <= circle.r * circle.r;
183:   }

185:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
